pulse.label: The Oaks storm back from 20 down in Indiana but the Pacers end the perfect start. Pacers 104 - Oaks 100
pulse.notes: The Oaks' perfect start ends at four. In Indiana, in front of a building at 90% capacity, the Pacers built a 61-42 halftime lead behind a 34-point second quarter and led 82-62 after three. The Oaks answered with 38 points in the fourth and won the quarter 38-22, but the comeback came up four short, Pacers 104 - Oaks 100. Adash Stanley and Austin Reaves led the way with 19 apiece. Stanley hit 5 of 11 from three, and Reaves had 7 assists and 6 rebounds without a turnover. AJ Dybantsa added 15, Wendell Carter Jr. went 5 for 6 for 10 points and 7 rebounds, and T. Jerome chipped in 10 points and 5 assists. The Oaks fall to 4-1.
